title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
source: 2 source Matrix using SDB (shnid=2192) and AUD (shnid=122155)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’82 hidden gem with a smoking Scarlet>Fire and Let It Grow, captured in a good‑but slightly echo‑laden matrix.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its nonstop fire – standout performances of Scarlet > Fire, Let It Grow, Tiger and Baby Blue – and Jerry’s vocals and guitar are described as flawless. The matrix source delivers overall solid sound, though one reviewer notes an echo and sync issues that make the mix feel a bit off.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviewers give 5‑star praise for the musical performance, while one gives 2 stars due to recording sync problems; weighting shows strong show quality and decent but imperfect matrix sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally solid matrix mix with clear instrument separation, but a noticeable echo and occasional out‑of‑sync elements were reported by one reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as excellent from start to finish, with a seamless flow and high‑energy pacing throughout both sets.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for flawless vocals and guitar work on Tiger; no blown lyrics in Scarlet>Fire; consistently on point throughout the show.
